title: BF-CBOM normalised CBOM (CBOM^norm), version bf-cbom-norm/1
description: One file per stored CBOM (run<k>.norm.json next to run<k>.json), the same shape for every tool. Written by analysis/normalize (adapter spec per tool in analysis/adapters/). Canonical values come from analysis/data/algorithms.yaml and the CycloneDX 1.7 registry; every value keeps its raw form and the path it was read from.

fallback.description: true: the tool has no spec, the generic CycloneDX reader was used

registry.description: lastUpdated of the vendored CycloneDX cryptography registry

source.description: the original CBOM: file name next to this file, its sha256 (detects a stale normalisation), snapshot, variant, run

reader.description: cyclonedx, or the bomFormat of a non-CycloneDX dialect (CBOM)

checked_against.description: official schema the values were checked against, e.g. 'CycloneDX 1.6'; null when none applies

spec_issues.description: issue count per kind (field, enum, type, deprecated, dialect, version)

record_id.description: <tool>:<component index>:<occurrence index>; stable for a stored CBOM

group.description: coarse family (analysis/data/families.yaml names): RSA, EC, AES, SHA-2, RANDOM, TLS, CERT, ...

family.description: CycloneDX 1.7 registry family (AES, RSAES-OAEP, ECDSA, SHA-2, ...) or a documented addition (RSA, EC, CSPRNG, PRNG, ...)

algorithm.description: specific variant (SHA-256, Ed25519, ML-KEM-768); otherwise equal to family

param_set.description: parameter identifier that is neither a key size nor a digest

confidence.description: as reported; scales differ per tool

line_end.description: end of a reported line window (IBM draft detectionContext)

in_scope.description: a source file of the repository's language

file_exists.description: the path exists at the scanned commit (absent without the git mirror)

context.description: occurrence evidence: API call, matched symbol, code line or snippet (shortened)

ambiguous.description: a name listing several algorithms that no other source resolved

raw.description: per dimension the value as found (a field value or the whole text that was parsed)

src.description: per dimension the JSON path or source it came from; derived:<dim> for our derivations

via.description: per dimension: field, parse, dictionary, interpretive (a judgement entry of the tool spec), api, dependency, ref or derived

conflicts.description: per dimension a lower-precedence value that contradicts the kept one
